en.description:
A tiny pet lives on your wrist.

Pippet is a virtual pet made for Apple Watch — not a phone game squeezed onto a
small screen. Glance at your wrist and your pet is there, doing its own thing.

STROKE IT WITH THE DIGITAL CROWN
Turn the crown slowly and feel every gentle tick in your wrist — like a purr you
can actually feel. Spin fast and it giggles.

YOUR STEPS ARE ITS FOOD
Pippet feeds on your real activity. A good walk keeps your pet full and happy.
Or lift a treat to its mouth with the crown and watch it chomp.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
Put your pet on your watch face. It changes expression through the day all on
its own — hungry at noon, curled up asleep at night.

IT GROWS WITH YOU
Hatch a mystery egg, name your pet, and watch it grow through four life stages.
Three species to discover, each with its own little plant crown.

KIND BY DESIGN
Your pet never dies. Neglect it and it just naps until you come back — one touch
wakes it up. No guilt, no punishment. No subscription, no ads, no paid revivals.
When you're ready for a new friend, your old one rests safely in your codex.
en.releaseNotes:
• Send your pet to stay with a friend for a day, by link. They play together, and your friend sends back a note about how it went.
• Have a guest? Stroke it, share your treats and find its favourite — and watch the two play ball, dance, touch noses and nap side by side.
• A game room with two new games: Pairs (turn the cards and find the matching treats and treasures, on iPhone and Apple Watch) and Bubbles on iPhone and Apple Watch — aim (with the Digital Crown on the watch), bounce off the walls and pop three of a kind before the bubbles reach your pet.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Sorry about the rough start — the first release could crash the moment your
egg hatched. That's fixed, so your pet can finally hatch and settle in on
your wrist.

• Fixed a crash when the pet appeared on screen
• Improved layout on smaller Apple Watch models

Every pet is now one of a kind.

• Personality — each pet is born Sleepy, Playful, Foodie, Shy or Curious, and it
  shows in everything it does.
• Yesterday with your pet — a little card each morning: your steps, your care, and
  what your pet got up to.
• Favourite treats — every pet loves one snack and isn't keen on another. Find out
  which by feeding!
• Treasures — your pet brings little finds home from your walks. Collect all 12.
• Trains and sleeps with you — after a workout your pet is bursting with energy, and
  it learns your bedtime so it sleeps when you do.
• Close your rings, feed your pet — every Activity ring you close is a feast.
• Care streaks and 13 milestones — a missed day won't wipe your streak: leaves you
  earn along the way protect it.
• Grow-up styles — the way you care shapes your pet's adult look: cuddly, sporty,
  chubby or balanced.
• Seasons — blossom in spring, orange leaves in autumn, a cosy scarf in winter.
• Two new species — Sunny and the rare Frosty. A gold-speckled egg means
  something special is inside.
• Little fixes.

Dress up your pet!

• Wardrobe — earn a bow tie, a medal, a flower pin, a bell collar and a little
  crown by reaching milestones. Your pet wears it everywhere, even on your
  watch face.
• Workshop — the treasures your pet brings home from your walks now have a
  use: make a daisy wreath, a leaf scarf, a shell necklace, a mushroom hat or
  a starry tiara.
• Treasures turn up more often — your first thing to make is just a day's
  walk away.
• Memories — a little album of your story together: hatching, growing up,
  milestones, special finds and everything you've made.
• Dress your pet from your iPhone too — bigger previews, and your watch
  updates through iCloud.
• Pippet now speaks Kazakh and Simplified Chinese. Choose your language right
  in the iPhone app.
• Fixed: in Catch the treats, a small turn of the Digital Crown no longer
  flings your pet from edge to edge.

Pippet now lives on your iPhone too.

• Stroke, feed and play with your pet on iPhone.
• No Apple Watch? Raise your pet on iPhone alone.
• Have both? It's one pet, synced through iCloud.
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.
• Soft sounds on iPhone (they follow the silent switch).
• Bug fixes.

• Send your pet to stay with a friend for a day, by link. They play together, and your friend sends back a note about how it went.
• Have a guest? Stroke it, share your treats and find its favourite — and watch the two play ball, dance, touch noses and nap side by side.
• A game room with two new games: Pairs (turn the cards and find the matching treats and treasures, on iPhone and Apple Watch) and Bubbles on iPhone and Apple Watch — aim (with the Digital Crown on the watch), bounce off the walls and pop three of a kind before the bubbles reach your pet.
